versions.changelog: Added optional Pro add-on link (final-cut assembly script, comic-grid template library, quick-start script, video tutorial). Free version unchanged.

v1.0.1 (2026-09-06): Security hardening — export_prompts.py now validates shot_id against a whitelist ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+) and sanitizes generated filenames (safe_name()), fixing a path-traversal risk flagged by ClawHub scan T09.
Initial release: 4-step storyboard prompt pipeline, 6 model dialects (Jimeng/Kling/Hailuo H3/Seedance/Vidu/Runway), character consistency anchors, batch export script with manifest output.
